# Dependency payload intentionally not vendored

This directory existed in the supplied publication archive and contained dependency material from other components.
The dependency source/binaries are intentionally **not** copied into this project source tree. This keeps ownership and provenance clear and avoids publishing another project as if it belonged here.

Use the corresponding first-class component in this repository (or the dependency named by the project documentation) when assembling a runnable environment.
